[[Geoff Bowman]] posted the address for '''22 July 2025 Vegas Nights''' as Knight & Day Games, 6521 S Las Vegas Blvd, Suite C-105, Las Vegas.<ref name="addr">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1385867884810600550/1397013557144457246 redv, Star Wars CCG Discord #vegas-nights-pt2, 22 July 2025].</ref> [[Clayton Moore]] said the night had four players plus guest Casey.<ref name="four">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1385867884810600550/1397463189192708116 cmoore89, Star Wars CCG Discord #vegas-nights-pt2, 23 July 2025].</ref><ref name="casey">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1385867884810600550/1397463310697500682 cmoore89, Star Wars CCG Discord #vegas-nights-pt2, 23 July 2025].</ref> No winner was named.
